The decisive mistake was the replanning script at step 82. It filtered issues by the keyword "numpy.polynomial" in the title or body instead of using the repository's `component: numpy.polynomial` label, which appeared in the label list at step 75. That returned issue #22669, a 2022 issue, as the "oldest" match. Every later step built on that wrong issue, and step 103 then reported its creation date as the label-addition date. The expected answer, 04/15/18, is the date the Regression label was added to an older issue that this filter never reached.
